name: Every Price Point, Honestly Ranked
why_it_works: Shoppers fear overpaying and fear buying cheap. Walking up the price ladder and saying where the value actually peaks feels like insider honesty, especially when the brand admits its top tier is not for everyone. That candor is what makes the recommended tier convert.

hook.pattern: Rank your own tiers by value, not by price, and admit where the sweet spot is.

craft.notes: Rank by value per dollar and mark the exact slide where returns diminish. Telling people to skip the top tier is the credibility move; the top tier still gets its own spotlight slide so aspirational buyers self-select.

do_not: Invent tiers you do not sell
Recommend the most expensive tier as the sweet spot
Use words like investment or appreciates in value for jewelry or luxury goods
compliance: Jewelry: state metal purity and stone origin accurately; follow FTC jewelry guides on terms like natural, lab-grown and solid gold
